description: This file implements classes and functions for managing active tags in a testing framework, including value objects for tag comparisons, tag matchers for skip/run logic, and value providers for dynamic tag values.

classes.name: ValueObject
classes.description: Represents a value with an associated comparison function for active tag logic.

classes.name: NumberValueObject
classes.description: A ValueObject that compares integer values.

classes.name: BoolValueObject
classes.description: A ValueObject that compares boolean values.

classes.name: TagMatcher
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the protocol for tag matchers.

classes.name: ActiveTagMatcher
classes.description: Implements tag matching logic for categories with support for inclusion/exclusion patterns.

classes.name: PredicateTagMatcher
classes.description: A tag matcher based on a predicate function.

classes.name: CompositeTagMatcher
classes.description: Combines multiple tag matchers into one.

classes.name: IActiveTagValueProvider
classes.description: Interface for active tag value providers.

classes.name: ActiveTagValueProvider
classes.description: Default implementation of a value provider using a dict-like data store.

classes.name: CompositeActiveTagValueProvider
classes.description: Combines multiple value providers into one.

methods.name: use_value
methods.description: Re-evaluates a value if it is callable.

methods.name: print_active_tags
methods.description: Prints a summary of current active tag values.

methods.name: setup_active_tag_values
methods.description: Updates existing active tag values with data from a dict.
